_readme: Copy this folder to trips/YYYY-MM-destination/ and replace the values below. Every page renders from this file — never edit the HTML. Field reference: README.md. Delete any section you don't need; pages show a placeholder instead of breaking. Delete this _readme key too.
title: Destination — short descriptor
notes: Optional free-text intro shown on the trip home page.
_exchangeRate: rate = homeCurrency units per `per` units of tripCurrency. Japan quotes per 100 JPY; somewhere like Europe would use per: 1. Omit this whole block for a domestic trip and cost columns collapse to one currency.
_costCategories: Optional. Overrides the default buckets (transport, fuel, food, sightseeing, misc) used by day costs. Keys must match the keys used in days[].items[].costs.

summary.note: Optional caveat shown at the top of the budget page — e.g. whether figures are one person's share or the whole group's.

_flights: Shown as cards on the trip home page — outbound, return, and any internal legs. `type` is free text (Outbound / Return / Internal). All times are local to their own airport. Set `arrivesNextDay` true for a red-eye. Check-in is shown automatically as 3 hours before departure; set `checkInTime` to pin an exact time, or `checkInLeadHours` to change the offset for one flight (a top-level `checkInLeadHours` changes it for the whole trip).

flights.remarks: Delete this card if the trip has no internal flights.
Overnight flight — checkInTime here is pinned rather than derived.

_budget: Amounts in homeCurrency. `perDay` and `actual` are optional; leave actual null while planning and fill it in after the trip.
_settle: Optional — only for group trips where one person pays up front. Keys inside `amounts` must match the names in `travelers`. Use null where a traveller isn't part of that line.

settle.label: Accommodation
settle.remarks: Charged to one card, split evenly.

_overview: One row per day. Each day renders as three colour-banded rows — morning, afternoon, evening — with its own remark per slot. `remarks` is a whole-day note shown on its own row underneath. `temperature` is a list in Celsius; give one entry per place the day passes through, and use `note` instead of min/max when it isn't a plain range. The hotel shown in the Staying in column is matched automatically from `accommodation` by date.

overview.remarks: Optional note that applies to the whole day.

_days: The detailed plan — one entry per day, each with a timeline of items. `costs` keys are the cost categories, amounts in tripCurrency. Costs roll up automatically into the day total and the budget page. city/weekday/temperature are pulled from `overview` when generating, so they can be repeated here.

days.summary: Optional one-line framing for the day.

items.activity: Arrive and take the airport train into town
items._travel: Optional. Adds a Google Maps directions link to this activity. `duration`, `distance` and `cost` are your own estimates — the page cannot compute them (see README). `mode` is driving | transit | walking | bicycling.

items.activity: Check in, then dinner near the hotel
Check out and head to the airport

_accommodation: Prices in homeCurrency. `perPerson` is optional — include it for group trips to get the split table; use null for anyone not sharing that stay.
_transport: Optional. `legs` is a travel log — drop it for a walk-everywhere city trip and just keep `mode`. `day` refers to the trip day number so each leg links to its day page.
_todo: Pre-trip checklist. `status` of exactly "Done" renders as a completed badge; anything else renders as pending.
